notes.recognition: The small point and expanding mineral wave read as a reveal effect.
notes.agency: The effect directs attention without inventing a reward or outcome.
notes.specificity: The irregular mineral wave and broken hex echo avoid a generic scanner treatment.
notes.restraint: Most of the canvas remains transparent and the signal stays quiet.
notes.continuity: Blueprint cyan and the faint oxide trace keep the established semantic roles.
notes.reusability: True alpha and broad padding support additive layering at multiple scales.
notes.accessibility: Shape and luminance communicate the reveal, though the faintest trace is color-dependent.
